# tonal

> tonal is a functional music theory library for JavaScript and TypeScript:
> notes, intervals, chords, scales, modes, keys, Roman numerals, voicings and
> more. It works with musical abstractions (note names, not audio). All
> functions are pure and invalid input returns empty values instead of
> throwing.

Install with `npm install tonal` and import namespaces from it:
`import { Note, Chord, Scale, Key } from "tonal"`. Each namespace is also
published on its own as `@tonaljs/<name>`.

Before writing code with tonal, read the agent guide, then look up the functions
you need in the API list instead of guessing their names.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/agents.md): how tonal works, mistakes to avoid,
  which function to use for common tasks
- [API](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/llms-api.txt): every public function with its signature,
  return type and a one-line description. It's also in the npm package at
  `node_modules/tonal/llms-api.txt`, matching the installed version
- [Getting started](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/index.md)

## Basics

- [Notes](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/basics/notes.md): Parse and manipulate notes
- [Intervals](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/basics/intervals.md): Calculate and manipulate intervals
- [Midi](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/basics/midi.md): Manipulate midi notes

## Chord and scales

- [Chords](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/groups/chords.md): Get and manipulate chords
- [Chord detection](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/groups/chord-detection.md): Find the chord names of a list of notes
- [Scales](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/groups/scales.md): Work with scales
- [Pitch Class Sets](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/groups/pitch-class-sets.md): Compare collections of notes

## Harmony

- [Chord charts](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/harmony/charts.md): Bars, sections, meters, repeats, endings and jumps, the played form, and the chord at a position
- [Keys](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/harmony/keys.md): Key scales and chords
- [Modes](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/harmony/modes.md): Greek modes dictionary
- [Progressions](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/harmony/progressions.md): Parse and create harmonic progressions

## Voicings

- [Chord Voicings](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/voicings/voicings.md): Voice any chord or progression, with voices, tensions, bass, templates and spacing
- [Voice leading](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/voicings/leading.md): Voice-leading distance and the smoothest path between voicings
- [Voicing dictionary (deprecated)](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/voicings/dictionary.md): The old dictionaries of chord voicings, replaced by Voicing options and templates

## Notation

- [ABC Notation](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/notation/abc-notation.md): Convert note names between scientific and abc notation
- [Roman Numerals](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/notation/roman-numerals.md): Functions to parse roman numerals

## Time, Rhythm and Patterns

- [Time duration](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/time/duration.md)
- [Note Patterns](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/time/note-patterns.md): Arpeggio orders and melodic sequences as lists of indexes
- [Rhythm Patterns](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/time/patterns.md): Generate, read and measure rhythm patterns
- [Time signatures](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/time/signatures.md)
- [Time](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/time/time.md): Positions, durations, meters and bar:beat as exact fractions of quarter notes

## Dictionaries

- [Chord dictionary](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/dictionaries/chord-types.md): A dictionary of musical chords.
- [Scale dictionary](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/dictionaries/scale-types.md): A dictionary of musical scales.

## Utils

- [Collections](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/utils/collections.md)
- [Ranges](https://tonaljs.github.io/tonal/docs/utils/ranges.md)

## Optional
